longDescription: Turn eleven Ulanzi D200 keys into a shared tic-tac-toe game. Arrange the nine position-guided cell actions in a 3 by 3 grid, choose X or O from the New Game Property Inspector, keep the final board visible, show Victory, Defeat, or Draw on New Game for five seconds, and track X wins, O wins, and draws for the current plugin session. No account or network connection is required.
